# Alpine A110 — Reparaturhandbuch (Typ A 110), German factory repair handbook

> Front matter above this line is generated by `scripts/10_write_frontmatter.py` once the
> manifest exists — do not hand-edit it.

## What this manual is

The **German-language factory repair handbook** (*Reparaturhandbuch*) for the **Alpine A110
"Berlinette"**, issued under the joint **RENAULT · ALPINE** imprint. **468 PDF pages** — some
five times the size of the English-translation [`alpine-a110`](../a110/README.md) manual
already in this repo, and far more detailed.

The cover states the coverage directly:

> **REPARATURHANDBUCH — Typ A 110**
> **1300 VA, 1300 VB, 1300 VC, 1600 VB, GS**
> *(1300 V85 · 1300 G/S · 1600 S)*

The text is **typewritten German**, clean and well printed, with line-art figures and
exploded views throughout. It is an original German document, **not** a translation — which
is the single biggest reason to prefer it over the existing English A110 manual (see
*Relationship to the other A110 manual* below).

### Edition / date

The handbook carries **no printed edition statement or date** that this scan shows. The
chassis-number table runs through **September 1975 – August 1976**, so the book is at least a
**1976-or-later** printing. Dating it more precisely than that is not possible from this copy.

## The car — background (best-effort, NOT from the manual; review pending)

The A110 is a rear-engined, rear-wheel-drive sports coupé: a polyester (fibreglass) body on a
central steel backbone chassis, using Renault running gear throughout. Built 1961–1977; it won
the inaugural 1973 World Rally Championship. Because the mechanicals are Renault, this handbook
doubles as a Renault 8/10/12/16/17 reference in places — see the cross-reference table below.

## What this manual covers

Chassis / version coverage, from the manual's own chassis-number table (p.6) — **this is wider
than the English manual's**, running from the 1969 model year to the end of production:

| Version | Build period covered |
|---|---|
| 1300 V85 | September 1969 – August 1976 (to end of production) |
| 1300 G | September 1969 – end of production |
| 1300 S | September 1969 – end of production |
| 1600 / 1600 S | September 1969 – end of production |
| 1600 S (VB) and 1600 S (VC) | split out from September 1971 |
| **1600 SC** | September 1972 – August 1974 |
| **1600 SC/SI** | September 1974 – end of production |

The **1600 SC and SC/SI are present here and absent from the English manual**, which stops at
1973.

### Vehicle types and engine codes

Read off the manual's own **"Wichtigste Einstellungen"** quick-reference plate (printed p.12 /
PDF p.13) and **verified against the rendered page image**, not against OCR — the OCR of this
plate is badly mangled. The plate is headed *"RENAULT ALPINE ⬥ A 110 (außer Rennausrüstung und
Gruppe IV)"* — i.e. **excluding racing equipment and Group IV**.

| Fahrzeugtyp | Motortyp | Hubraum | Oil fill |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1300 VC | 810-05 | 1289 cm³ | 3 L + filter 0.25 L + oil cooler 0.50 L |
| 1600 VD | 844-30 (SC), 844-34 (SI) | 1605 cm³ | 4 L + filter 0.30 L + oil cooler 0.50 L |
| 1600 VH | 843-30 | 1647 cm³ | 4 L + filter 0.30 L |
| 1600 VB / 1600 VC | 807-25 (1600 VB), 844-32 (1600 VC) | 1565 (807-25) / 1605 (844-32) cm³ | 4 L + filter 0.3 L + oil cooler 0.50 L |

**This is wider than the cover states.** The cover lists only `1300 VA, 1300 VB, 1300 VC,
1600 VB, GS`, but the book also carries **1600 VD** and **1600 VH** — the later SC and SI cars,
with Weber 45 DCOE carburettors or **electronic fuel injection** (*elektronische
Benzineinspritzung*). The book is evidently a composite of the base handbook plus later
supplement material.

### Sections

Taken from the manual's own `Inhaltsverzeichnis` (contents, pp.1–5). Printed page numbers;
the PDF page offset is **not constant** (the book has suffixed pages such as `114a`), so the
manifest resolves each chapter to PDF pages from an OCR-derived page map.

| Section (German, as printed) | English |
|---|---|
| Zuordnung von Fahrgestellnummern zum Herstellungszeitpunkt | Chassis numbers → build date |
| Renault u. Alpine Typenbezeichnungen mit zugehörigen Motoren u. Getrieben | Renault/Alpine type codes with their engines and gearboxes |
| Wartungsdiagnose | Maintenance diagnosis |
| Allgemeines, Konzeption des Fahrzeuges, Techn. Daten | General, vehicle design, technical data |
| Motor, Zündung | Engine, ignition — data, removal/refitting, head, liners, pistons, con-rods, crank, timing, lubrication |
| Motortypen 807 / 843 / 844 — Instandsetzung | Engine types 807/843/844 — overhaul |
| Motortyp 810 — Instandsetzung | Engine type 810 — overhaul |
| Motortyp 812 — Instandsetzung | Engine type 812 — overhaul |
| Zündanlage (alle Typen) | Ignition — points gap, static timing, advance curves |
| Kraftstoffversorgung | Fuel system — 1600 S, 1300 VC and 1300 G/S carburettors, synchronisation, idle |
| Kühlsystem (alle Typen) | Cooling — drain, fill, bleed (front and rear radiator) |
| Kupplung | Clutch — variants, identification, replacement, free play, release bearing and fork |
| Getriebe | Gearboxes — **353 / 364** and **330**: data, overhaul, cone distance, backlash, diff bearings, shift linkage, tooth-contact check |
| Lenkung (alle Typen) | Steering — rack overhaul, pinion end-float, Hardy disc |
| Vorderachse (alle Typen) | Front axle — camber, castor, toe, setting, half-axle and wishbone overhaul, hubs/bearings |
| Hinterachse (alle Typen) | Rear axle — half-axles, UJs, axle tubes, hubs and bearings, alignment |
| Aufhängung – Stoßdämpfer (alle Typen) | Suspension and dampers — spring characteristics, front/rear dampers and springs |
| Bremssystem (alle Typen) | Brakes — data, operation, fault-finding, calipers, master cylinders (single and tandem), pressure proportioning valve, discs |
| Bremskraftverstärker "Hydrovac" | "Hydrovac" brake servo — data, description, servicing, fault-finding |
| Elektrische Ausrüstung (alle Typen) | Electrical — component list, wiring diagram, cable directory, bulb table, alternators and regulators, starter overhaul (Ducellier 6183, Paris-Rhône), alternator overhaul (SEV, Paris-Rhône) |
| Karosserie | Body — minor damage repair, panel replacement, paint types and identification, polyurethane lacquer and primer composition, screen sealing |
| Fahrgestell | Chassis — chassis/front-axle/rear-axle checking, body jig, chassis dimension and check-dimension drawings, chassis and front crossmember replacement |

## What it does NOT cover

- **No owner/driver content and no parts catalogue.**
- **Gearbox 365 and later units are referenced but not overhauled here.** The type
  cross-reference table lists gearboxes 330, 352, 353, 364, 365, 367, 369, 385 and 395 across
  the Renault/Alpine range, but only **353/364 and 330** get overhaul chapters.
- **The 1600 SC/SI appears in the chassis-number table but is not separately overhauled** —
  there is no dedicated SC/SI engine chapter.
- The handbook disclaims liability in its own words at the end of the contents: advice is given
  to the best of knowledge *"jedoch unter Ausschluß jeglicher Haftung"* — but excluding all
  liability.

## Relationship to the other A110 manual in this repo

This repo also holds [`alpine-a110`](../a110/README.md) — the 87-page **English translation**
of the October 1970 French original. The two are complementary, and where they disagree **this
German handbook is the better source**:

| | `alpine-a110` (English) | `alpine-a110-reparaturhandbuch` (this one) |
|---|---|---|
| Pages | 87 | 468 |
| Language | English — **machine translation** of the French | **Original German** |
| Years | 1970–1971 | 1969 – end of production (incl. 1600 SC, SC/SI) |
| Engine overhaul | Specification only | **Full overhaul: 807/843/844, 810, 812** |
| Gearbox overhaul | Specification only | **Full overhaul: 353/364, 330** |
| Known defects | Abridged scan, many pages missing; garbled translation ("BOX OF VITSES", "scumbags"); numbers mangled twice | Complete scan; original-language text |

The English manual's README warns that **every torque, clearance and capacity in it is
provisional** because it was mangled by OCR *and* by machine translation. This handbook has no
translation layer in the source, so its numbers are one OCR pass away from the printed page
rather than two.

## Provenance caveats — read before trusting a number

1. **This wiki is an English translation made by this conversion, not by the publisher.** The
   source is German. Chapter prose and headings here are translated to English per the
   contributor's choice. **No unit is converted and no digit is changed** (cleanup Rule 0) —
   `m.daN` and `mkp` stay as the page prints them. The one thing that IS normalized is the
   **decimal separator**: the German source writes `0,044 mm`, and this wiki writes
   `0.044 mm`, because an English-language wiki that kept the comma would show its readers a
   number that looks wrong. Thousands separators go the same way (`10.000 km` → `10,000 km`).
   Notation changes; value does not. Where a German term's translation is genuinely uncertain,
   the printed German word is recorded in a `NEEDS REVIEW` note so it stays auditable.
2. **The source PDF's existing text layer was unusable and was discarded.** It was produced by
   *Adobe Acrobat Pro DC Paper Capture* and is badly garbled (the contents page reads
   `In.~altsverzeichnis`, `Identifi zi e:rung`). This conversion **re-OCR'd all 468 pages from
   the images** with Tesseract `deu+eng`, with deskew and page rotation.
3. **The scan carries a "DerFranzose" watermark** diagonally across every page — a German
   Renault/Alpine parts retailer. It overlaps figures and some body text, and is a known source
   of OCR noise. It is part of the scan, not the original book.
4. **The cover page is clipped at the bottom in the scan itself** — the "RENAULT ◆ ALPINE"
   imprint is cut off. This is how the page was scanned; it is not a page-box artefact and
   reframing does not recover it. Content pages are framed correctly and are not affected.
5. **Page numbering is not continuous with the PDF, and the offset drifts.** The book
   interleaves unnumbered plate and divider pages, so the printed-to-PDF offset grows steadily
   from **−1 at the front to +10 by the electrical and body chapters**; it also inserts suffixed
   pages (e.g. `114a`). There is no single constant to apply. A page map built from the OCR text
   resolves **395 of 468** pages; the unresolved ones are the unnumbered plates. Citations in
   this wiki give the **printed** page, with the PDF page alongside it.
6. **Page boxes were reframed before OCR.** The source stores pages rotated, with page boxes
   that do not match the scanned image. The pipeline's normaliser reframed **372 of 468** pages
   to the image bounding box before OCR; the output is upright A4 with no rotation. Renders were
   spot-checked by hand afterwards and content pages are complete.
7. **One page carries no OCR text.** PDF page 468 (the back cover) returned "too few characters"
   and was skipped by Tesseract.
